title: Jazzy Char Grilled Pork Chops with Hash Browns
description: A flavorful and juicy grilled pork chop dish served with crispy hash browns, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat grill to 400°F (200°C). Season pork chops with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and onion powder.
Grill pork chops for 5-7 minutes per side or until they reach 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add grated potatoes and cook for 5 minutes or until golden brown.
Add hash to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve pork chops with hash browns and garnish with chopped parsley.
Cook time for hash browns: 5 minutes.
Cook time for pork chops: 10-14 minutes.
Grill pork chops at 400°F (200°C) to ensure food safety.
